newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Edenor to issue $120 mln bond.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Edenor to issue $120 mln bond.

text.p: Argentine electricity distribution firm Edenor SA said Monday it will sell $120 million in non-negotiable bonds.

The bond will be issued on December 4 at a price of 99.69. It has a coupon of 9.75 percent and matures on December 4, 2001. Interest will be paid every six months, with the first payment due on June 4, said the electricity distributor.
Underwriters of the issue are Citibank International Plc, JP Morgan Securities Ltd, Banco Rio de la Plata, Societe Generale and Credit Lyonnais.
The issue is part of Edenor's $300 million negotiable bond program approved in November.
